```lean
theorem lg_target {R : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [LieRing N] [LieAlgebra R N] [LieRing M] [LieAlgebra R M] (i : N →ₗ⁅R⁆ L) (p : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ M) : i.range = LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra R L p.ker ↔ Function.Exact ⇑i ⇑p := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    apply LieHom.isIdealMorphism_def
    exact (LieHom.map_le_idealRange i p.ker)
  · intro h
    haveI : i.range ≤ p.ker := (LieHom.le_ker_iff i p.ker).mp h
    have : i.range = ⊥ := (LieIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff i p.ker).mp (LieIdeal.map_le_iff_le_comap i p.ker h)
    rw [this]
    apply LieHom.isIdealMorphism_def
    exact (LieHom.map_le_idealRange i p.ker)
```
